'''Sewer Clam''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Sewer Clam}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Jet
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (10;{{Asc2|9|11}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Pressurize
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 4 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always uses {{Int2|Sewer Clam|Jet}} first. Then alternates between {{Int2|Sewer Clam|Pressurize}} and {{Int2|Sewer Clam|Jet}} every turn.

== Trivia ==
* Each time '''Sewer Clam''' uses {{Int2|Sewer Clam|Pressurize}}, the coral on it grows larger.
